Harbor Line Ferry: Schedule

Harbor Line Ferry runs between Pier 4 and Gull Island. The last weekday departure from Pier 4 is 10:40 p.m. Saturday and Sunday last departures leave at 9:15 p.m. Boarding closes ten minutes before departure. The crossing takes thirty five minutes in clear weather.

Harbor Line Ferry: Fares

Adult fare is 14 dollars each way. The senior fare is 7 dollars with photo identification. Children under five ride free. A bicycle pays a 3 dollar rack fee and must sit on the stern rack. Tickets are sold at the Pier 4 window until boarding closes.

Harbor Line Ferry: Safety

Life jackets are stored in the port locker beside the wheelhouse. In a medical emergency, call the duty officer on channel 16 and then the harbor clinic at 555-0148. Fog delays hold the boat at the dock until visibility exceeds one mile. Do not board during a posted fog hold.

Harbor Line Ferry: Freight

The deck crane limit is 800 pounds. Live animals travel only in approved crates on the freight well. Propane and loose fuel are refused. Freight closes twenty minutes before departure.
